body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes TypeScript compilation errors in the RLS (Row-Level Security) and SCIM helper factory functions that were blocking CI builds.

**Changes:**
- Added explicit `priority: 0` to four RLS factory functions (`ownerPolicy`, `tenantPolicy`, `rolePolicy`, `allowAllPolicy`)
- Added type assertion for generic `Resources` field in SCIM `listResponse` helper
- Generated JSON schema files and documentation for RLS and SCIM types

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 44 out of 44 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/permission/rls.zod.ts | Fixed TypeScript errors by adding explicit `priority: 0` to all four RLS helper factory functions |
| packages/spec/src/auth/scim.zod.ts | Fixed TypeScript error by casting generic `resources` parameter to union type constraint |
| packages/spec/json-schema/permission/*.json | Generated JSON schemas for RLS types (RowLevelSecurityPolicy, RLSConfig, RLSUserContext, RLSOperation, RLSEvaluationResult) |
| packages/spec/json-schema/auth/*.json | Generated JSON schemas for SCIM types (SCIMUser, SCIMGroup, SCIMListResponse, SCIMError, and related sub-types) |
| content/docs/references/permission/rls/*.mdx | Generated documentation pages for RLS schema references |
| content/docs/references/auth/scim/*.mdx | Generated documentation pages for SCIM schema references |
| content/docs/references/permission/meta.json | Added RLS to permission protocol documentation navigation |
| content/docs/references/auth/meta.json | Added SCIM to auth protocol documentation navigation |
</details>
